lessons: The code was fine: all 92 verification tests and lint passed. The check failed only on `ruff format --check`: the engine's meta refresh (`meta.refresh` in clutch/stages.py) stamped `# purpose: ` with a trailing space into 3 test files that lacked a purpose.

Redo the work from the merge base: change the stem and attempt rules in store.py, add `capture_key`, update the `captures` help text, update the test files, and add tests/unit/test_evidence_capture_keys.py.

In each touched test file, write the meta header yourself with a non-empty one-line `# purpose:` so refresh never renders an empty one: tests/unit/test_evidence_capture_keys.py, tests/unit/test_evidence_captures_store.py, tests/integration/test_evidence_captures_verb.py.

If a touched file still ends up with an empty purpose, run `uv run clutch meta fill <path>`, the paved road for empty_purpose named in clutch/stages.py. Then run `uv run ruff format --check .` after the meta commit and before you finish.

Engine cause, outside this fence: `meta._render` in clutch/meta.py writes `key: ` with a trailing space when a value is empty, and ruff format rejects it. This needs its own engine fix and should not be folded into this ticket.
